parent_files_modified_pre_enhancement.reason: user-authorized direct fix for Bug A (hardcoded PyPI supplier fallback) and Bug B (missing metadata.component in CycloneDX). Applied before step10 pipeline ran.

orchestrator_pattern.rationale: Step 8 unit tests explicitly assert `not isinstance(orch, ScanOrchestrator)`. EcosystemScanOrchestrator wraps parent ScanOrchestrator dependencies via injected constructor params rather than inheriting.

cache_wiring.rationale: EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper.map_vulnerabilities(deps, caches) accepts either (a) the rich {nvd, osv, ghsa} dict for ecosystem-aware dispatch, or (b) a plain dict for backward-compat with parent VulnerabilityMapper signature.

cpe_sanitization_layer.rationale: Defensive: parent CycloneDXSerializer does not currently propagate CPEs into component dicts, so the strip is mostly defensive. CPESanitizer also exposed as a standalone class for callers who do build CPE-bearing components from Syft output.

live_network_avoidance.rationale: OSVCache and GHSACache mirror parent NVDCacheManager pattern. No requests/httpx/urllib3/aiohttp imports. Static-check test in Step 5 verifies this.

module_loading_in_step10.rationale: Avoids module-name shadowing between parent step9_tdd_green_phase_orchestration.py and enhancement-side step9_tdd_green_phase_orchestration.py. sys.modules pre-registration required because @dataclass decorators introspect sys.modules[cls.__module__] during class definition.

known_limitations.lodash_4_17_20_no_hit: The fixture OSV record for lodash@4.17.20 marks the fix-version boundary as 4.17.21; lookups at exactly 4.17.20 return None per SEMVER half-open range semantics. This is correct behavior. The mock scenarios were calibrated to reflect this.
known_limitations.ghsa_cve_id_field: Some GHSA records in the fixture do not have a top-level cve_id (only GHSA ID). The mapper passes through whatever ID the OSV record carries; tests assert presence of either field.
known_limitations.live_osv_ghsa_disabled: All OSV/GHSA lookups are fixture-driven. A live-network mode behind a CLI flag is explicitly out of scope per the requirements; tests would need to be re-architected to support it.
